description: This is a PHP unit test class named EmployeeDaoTest, which tests the methods of EmployeeDao related to employee data access and manipulation within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The test cases verify various functionalities such as retrieving subordinate employee IDs, checking supervisor relationships, fetching employee shifts, filtering employees, and validating email availability.

classes.name: EmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeDao data access object, ensuring correct behavior of employee data retrieval, hierarchy, filtering, and email validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeDao instance and populates test data before each test method runs.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate IDs based on supervisor ID and hierarchy inclusion.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate employees for a given supervisor.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_Simple2LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Tests subordinate list retrieval with a simple two-level reporting hierarchy.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_3LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Tests subordinate list retrieval with a three-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if a given employee ID is recognized as a supervisor.

methods.name: getEmployeeIds
methods.description: Helper method that extracts employee IDs from a list of Employee objects.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdListOneEmployee
methods.description: Tests employee ID list after deleting all but one employee.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployees
methods.description: Tests deletion of employees by their IDs, including handling empty lists.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Checks retrieval of supervisor IDs for a given employee ID.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Validates retrieval of an employee's work shift details.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeList
methods.description: Verifies employee list retrieval with various filters and sorting options.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee numbers based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Checks the count of employees matching certain filter criteria.

methods.name: testGetEmailList
methods.description: Verifies the list of employee emails available in the database.

methods.name: testIsWorkEmailIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether an email address is available for use.
